name: Merge queue
author: Brett
description: Merge queue 2.0 (Pipeline 2.0, Nov 19 2026): a read-only view of every build waiting to land, live from the builds store, the same single source of truth the orchestrator and the lander read. One row a build: its status (building, build complete, merging to one PR, pulling in main, running CI, merging into main, or failed with the attempt) and how long it has been in it, its PRs, and its steps under the row (added to PR #N, model, slot). No state of its own and no actions: the lander (deploy/lander/run.mjs) lands everything by itself. Replaces the push banner's merge queue.

items.title: Merge queue: every build waiting to land
items.description: Every build waiting to land, read-only from the builds store: live status (failed shows the attempt), how long it has been in it, its PRs and its steps.
